newsitem.title: USA: Rural/Metro, Southwest Ambulance to merge.
newsitem.headline: Rural/Metro, Southwest Ambulance to merge.

text.p: Rural/Metro Corp on Wednesday said it has signed a letter of intent to merge with Southwest Ambulance, a private ambulance company in Arizona.

Terms of the proposed transaction were not disclosed. "Our combination with Southwest is an extension of our continuing strategy to build Rural/Metro's market presence and operational efficiencies in key geographies," Warren Rustand, Rural/Metro chief executive, said in a statement.
In its last fiscal year, Southwest Ambulance had revenue of about $30 million and responded to roughly 90,000 calls.
